title: Mountain dragon transformation
summary: A dire panda reveals a mountain dragon when wounded.
overview: A dire panda reveals a mountain dragon when wounded.

roles.label: Everyone
tips: Expect a fresh target at the panda's position and prepare before crossing 80%.

sections.title: Encounter plan
bullets: At 80% health the panda attempts to spawn the mountain dragon at its current position.
If that dragon is already present, the transformation is deferred and the health trigger is rearmed.
A successful transformation removes the panda.

notes: Approval E328. Source review only; deployment, database spell lists and live balance have not been verified.
